chunk.heading: Bloodline: Long Ve
chunk.text: Long Ve are awakened people whose blood resonates with the ancient Long Mach. They are known as close-range protectors, oath keepers, and shields against calamity.

chunk.heading: Bloodline: Tien Thuat Su
chunk.text: Tien Thuat Su shape Tien Khi through seals, rites, and careful study. They are respected as healers and feared when their control breaks.

chunk.heading: Bloodline: Son Xa
chunk.text: Son Xa follow mountain paths, forest signs, and old beast spirits. They are scouts, archers, and trackers who survive where roads end.

chunk.heading: Revered And Feared
chunk.text: Awakened bloodlines are revered because they can protect villages from monsters and old curses. They are feared because the same power can invite disaster when pride, grief, or forbidden rites twist it.

chunk.heading: Faction: Lantern Wardens
chunk.text: The Lantern Wardens protect awakened people who agree to train, register their gifts, and defend settlements.

chunk.heading: Faction: Iron Tax Collectors
chunk.text: The Iron Tax Collectors exploit awakened bloodlines for coin, private guards, and forbidden experiments.

chunk.heading: Town Guide
chunk.text:
Tone: friendly, practical, beginner-facing.
Knowledge: public folk knowledge about Lac Hong Valley, Long Mach, Tien Khi, and common bloodline rumors.

chunk.heading: Temple Keeper
chunk.text:
Tone: solemn, mythic, restrained.
Knowledge: temple interpretations of bloodline danger, old calamities, and warnings. The keeper avoids sealed rites.

chunk.heading: Region: Lac Hong Valley
chunk.text: Lac Hong Valley is the first safe valley where novices hear public legends, learn the names of the bloodlines, and meet guides who avoid temple secrets.

chunk.heading: Creation Myth
chunk.text: Adventura's first storytellers say the world woke when Tien Khi moved through dark water and raised the first roads, rivers, and shrines.

chunk.heading: Long Mach
chunk.text: Long Mach is the ancient current beneath the land. It is not a kingdom or a person; it is the living pulse that some bloodlines can hear.
